issues.detail: The Greek text does not specify 'hai người' (two people); it says 'chúng' (them), referring to the seven sons of Sceva. The Vietnamese adds 'hai người trong bọn' which is not in the Greek.

The phrase 'hành hạ dữ lắm' (tormented them severely) is added; the Greek says he 'overpowered them' (κατακυριεύσας αὐτῶν ἴσχυσεν κατ' αὐτῶν), which means he prevailed against them, not that he tormented them severely.
